samples.observation: The central carousel, overhead bowl and valves, bottle pockets, two transfer belts, guard ring, and HMI read as a rotary filler. Stainless, coated steel, polymer, and safety colors are distinct and coherent. No mismatch established.

The pump casing and ports, gearbox, guarded coupling, finned motor, and baseplate are recognizable. Stainless, painted drive, yellow guard, and seal colors map to separate material zones. No mismatch established.

The enclosure, service doors, heating section, mold stations, and control pedestal make a guarded stretch-blow station recognizable. Gray enclosure panels and coated base/control parts are plausible for this generic visualization. No clear material mismatch established.

The infeed, weighing, and outfeed surfaces were rendered as one continuous light-metal material with the support beds; no belt material or separate belt surfaces appeared. This is the sole material mismatch found. The short default description also claimed a reject output that was not modeled; its wording is corrected to describe the visible three-section weigh conveyor and signal tower.

The plate exchanger, balance tank, skid, control panel, and process piping read as a small pasteurizer skid. Stainless process surfaces and coated support/control parts are visually distinct. No mismatch established.

finding.before: The three conveying beds were colored stainless steel, with no separate belt surface or belt material control.
finding.correction: Add thin, separated infeed, weigh, and outfeed belt surfaces with a shared polymer material control and appearance-preset values. Keep the steel beds in the stainless control.
finding.sourceDescription: Three-section packed-case checkweigher with a separate infeed, isolated weigh belt, outfeed, and operator signal tower. Material controls: stainless support steel, powder-coated steel, polymer conveyor belts, and safety paint.
